mechanism: Classic risk-on/off: when equities weak, capital rotates into gilts (yield falls with demand); reverse when confidence returns. EA fits multiple linear regression via pseudo-inverse on Z-scaled OHLC of UKGB_Z4 gilts + UK100, target=UK100 close look_ahead ahead; forecast sign vs spot is model_forecast.

mechanism: Entries only when model_forecast agrees with RSI(20)>70 & WPR(30)>-20 (buy) or RSI<30 & WPR<-80 (sell). While in position, if model_forecast != open state, treat as AI-detected reversal and close. Self-refitting linear model works across timeframes without per-TF ONNX.
data_needed: Live gilts+UK100 OHLC; iRSI/iWPR buffers; fitted coefficients.
why_new_for_mis: Combines cross-market linear forecast with oscillator extremes into a discrete change/reversal sensor MIS can gate on.
quote: If our model is expecting a reversal, we will close our open positions.

mechanism: From M1 pct returns of the 11-stock basket, estimate covariance; SLSQP minimizes wᵀΣw with L1-norm(|w|)=1 and bounds w∈[−1,1]. Integerized weights vs UK100 unit (e.g. shorts in AAL,AZN,AV) open hedge legs when account equity loss breaches loss_limit—portfolio-variance sensor drives risk overlay. Also tested lead-lag corr (±20) without strong findings.

instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same 11 FTSE names; M1 returns for optimization; EA on UK100

mechanism: Python Keras: MinMaxScaler on EURUSD D1 closes; sequences of SAMPLE_SIZE=120; Conv1D(256)→MaxPool→LSTM(100)×2+Dropout→Dense(sigmoid). EarlyStopping on val_loss; export ONNX. In EA, daily ExtMin/ExtMax normalize last 120 closes; OnnxRun → denormalize; class PRICE_UP/DOWN/SAME by delta vs last close. Gate CNA/SMOC/Nash entries so buys need PRICE_UP and sells PRICE_DOWN.
data_needed: D1 close history (≥sample_size); ONNX model; rolling day min/max for norm.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1 (article); SAMPLE_SIZE=120 bars; tested on CNA/SMOC/Nash EAs
why_new_for_mis: Reusable Conv1D+LSTM sequence sensor that emits discrete up/same/down class used as a confluence gate across heterogeneous strategy engines.

mechanism: CNA EA already combines Fast Causality Inference prediction with RSI extremes, trend strength, volatility_ok, MA cross. DL ExtPredictedClass is AND-ed into buy/sell: prediction>ε & rsi<30 & … & dlsgnl==PRICE_UP (mirror for sells). Backtests: DL version more conservative (58 vs 1292 trades, lower DD, slightly better win rate) vs non-DL higher profit/risk.
data_needed: CNA prediction stream; RSI/MA/volatility features; ONNX DL class.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD (DL model D1); host EA period as configured in CNA/SMOC/Nash articles

mechanism: LFS (Armanfard et al.): per-sample binary feature mask F(i) via iterative weighted Euclidean distances—minimize intra-class / maximize inter-class separation with ε-constraint β∈[0,1], then Monte-Carlo binarize. Frequency of feature inclusion across samples yields locally relevant predictors that global selectors miss when regimes shift. LFSpy fit→fstar; export JSON; MQL5 Clfspy class-similarity classifier.
data_needed: N×M feature matrix X + class labels Y; hyperparameters alpha, tau, n_beta, nrrp, gamma, knn; JSON model for MT5.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Method-general; demos on synthetic 5-var data (export/import accuracy 92%); motivated for financial non-stationarity
why_new_for_mis: Local, sample-wise feature masks are a regime-aware sensing preprocessor—MIS can reselect which indicators matter as market neighborhoods change.
quote: Unlike traditional methods that seek a single optimal feature subset for all data, Local Feature Selection (LFS) identifies optimal subsets for specific local regions. This adaptability could be particularly useful for handling non-stationary data.
